tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: Look up one StackLégal provider fiche by canonical slug, alias (for example ga), or exact catalog name. Returns the same object as GET /api/v1/providers/{slug}. A name match is not a legal qualification. lang defaults to French.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: List StackLégal provider fiches. Same payload as GET /api/v1/providers. Pass ids to request specific slugs, 81 at most, in that order. Omit ids for the full catalog. Unknown slugs are returned in unknown and the rest still succeeds. lang defaults to French.

tools.name: scan_site
tools.description: Fetch one public URL once, without a consent cookie, and report trackers present on the first HTML response and Set-Cookie headers. JavaScript is not executed. Each tracker includes a provider slug when the scanner catalog maps it to a fiche, and the result links to the StackLégal scanner page. This

findings.detail: Description of "scan_site" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
